description: The Republic of Ireland's Health Service Executive (HSE) has approved UKALL14 consolidation phase cycles 2 and 4 as a treatment option for the treatment of adult patients (aged 25-65 years) with newly diagnosed, previously untreated acute lymphoblastic leukaemia (ALL) treated on UKALL14-protocol who are in remission but not eligible for allogeneic transplantation following treatment with consolidation phase 1 (for cycle 2) and consolidation phase 3 (for cycle 4). The treatment regimen notes that rituximab is to be included in CD20 positive patients (in general >20% positivity), and that the regimen may sometimes be used in patients aged >= 19 years with Philadelphia chromosome positive acute lymphoblastic leukaemia. Imatinib is included for Philadelphia chromosome positive patients.
